# Security policy

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to `support@coqsoft.com`.

Include:

- affected npm package and version;
- affected FastGrid/FastSheet runtime version;
- reproduction steps;
- expected security impact;
- whether the issue affects only the local example server or production code.

Do not publish license files, registered `FGridE.js` builds, API keys, customer
data or working exploits in a public GitHub issue.
